description: This file defines the TransactionInfo class used for managing transaction state, including participants, timestamps, exceptions, and transaction lifecycle methods within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: TransactionInfo
classes.description: Represents transaction metadata, including participants, timestamps, exceptions, and methods for managing transaction state and lifecycle.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Default constructor initializing participants and joined queue.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing transaction with specific id, timestamp, priority, and read-only flag.

methods.name: TransactionInfo
methods.description: Copy constructor used when transferring transaction info.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the transaction ID.

methods.name: Fork
methods.description: Creates a copy of the transaction info, incrementing pending calls.

methods.name: Join
methods.description: Enqueues another TransactionInfo instance to the joined queue.

methods.name: MustAbort
methods.description: Determines if the transaction must abort based on stored exception or pending calls.

methods.name: RecordException
methods.description: Records an exception that caused the transaction to abort.

methods.name: ReconcilePending
methods.description: Reconciles all joined transactions, merging their state.

methods.name: Union
methods.description: Merges another TransactionInfo into this one, combining participant data and timestamps.

methods.name: RecordRead
methods.description: Records a read access for a participant, updating timestamp if needed.

methods.name: RecordWrite
methods.description: Records a write access for a participant, updating timestamp if needed.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the transaction info for debugging.
